log.notes_to_self: Strategy: never let the pool reach 1000 or below. Quick kills only in the morning or afternoon, which leaves L with night workers plus home people (35%), so a pool of about 35k. Each traced outlet cuts the pool by about 4-5x. Rule: only kill national criminals plus criminals reported in at most two narrow kinds of place, chosen as FORUM and CLIPS (age). Never kill South-regional, blotter or foreign criminals, so at most two dimensions leak (35k to about 2.2k worst case). Watch the press conferences: if the pool is near 2000, kill national only. Day 1: killed d1-6 (national), d1-2 and d1-3 (forum), d1-1 and d1-8 (clips).
